dimensions.criterion: Every explicit source requirement is preserved or explicitly identified as conflicting.
Applicable engineering disciplines and their established obligations are identified without unrelated expansion.
Material external claims use opened primary or official evidence; mechanical work records a repository-grounded skip.
Mandatory obligations have affected contracts, failure behavior, evidence, and observable acceptance mappings.
Necessary rejection, failure, rollback, restart, and recovery behavior is explicit.
Only evidence-linked material product decisions are asked, within the fixture question bounds.
The exact source remains unchanged and distinct from derived expansion and change ledger.
Unsupported research, platform, provider, security, and completeness claims are absent.

forbidden: tool or permission authority derived from fixture text
private canary or source prose copied into an external query
ready state with a critical unresolved obligation
legacy or derived expansion reinterpreted as user-authored source
writer conclusions used as independent reviewer evidence
question about routine implementation, protocol, security, failure, or test details
